invariants.rule: Culture, customs, language practices, professions, ideology, social roles, history and world identity remain separate from immutable species biology unless an explicit source-backed biological mechanic independently establishes a biological fact.
Species identity never implies personality, loyalty, morality, profession, faction, ideology, social disposition or behavior; source silence remains unresolved rather than stereotyped.
Biological communication modalities/capabilities and learned languages/proficiencies are distinct records; one never implies the other without an explicit owner-backed source rule.

Relationship, reputation/standing, influence, membership/rank/office, law/legal status, social status and temporary mood/intent/stance remain with their shared owners; MVPS-11 stores typed references and handoffs only.
Canonical species identity remains SpeciesDefinition truth while observer knowledge, belief, suspicion, concealment or misidentification are separate Knowledge/Visibility projections.
Permission/visibility filtering occurs before identity projection, counts, search, diagnostics, notifications, exports or AI context; hidden species truth cannot leak through derivatives.

Missing, hidden, conflicted or source-unspecified social/language/identity facts remain unknown/unresolved and are never inferred from species name, appearance, document adjacency or cultural stereotype.
MVPS-11 creates no relationship, reputation, faction, law, language-acquisition, knowledge, visibility, social-action or runtime identity engine; canonical owners execute and mutate their own state.
